# Omni-Hub

> Developer resource list curated from supplied repositories.
Selected pick: TIGER-AI-Lab/WebsiteBench.
Descriptions are limited to supplied information.

## Resources

### 📈 Rising this month
- [XinaTian/MROffice](https://github.com/XinaTian/MROffice): Open source AI office editors for documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDF, code
- [opensetlabs/openset-llm](https://github.com/opensetlabs/openset-llm): Fast local CPU LLM inference, no GPU, 8 GB RAM, OpenAI compatible
- [TIGER-AI-Lab/WebsiteBench](https://github.com/TIGER-AI-Lab/WebsiteBench): Can AI agents rebuild websites through browser exploration?
- [amitshekhariitbhu/forward-deployed-engineer-roadmap](https://github.com/amitshekhariitbhu/forward-deployed-engineer-roadmap): Step by step roadmap to become an AI Forward Deployed Engineer, with blogs
- [beiwocaishijia/gezhi-sheets](https://github.com/beiwocaishijia/gezhi-sheets): Local AI spreadsheet assistant supporting GLM, Kimi, Doubao, DeepSeek, Qwen
- [thesysdev/opendashboards](https://github.com/thesysdev/opendashboards): Open Source Claude Dashboards
- [YellowLaborerMarket/Gemini-Config-Checker-](https://github.com/YellowLaborerMarket/Gemini-Config-Checker-): Chain region scanner for proxy configs to access Google AI Studio and Gemini

### 🔌 Free APIs
- [public-apis/public-apis](https://github.com/public-apis/public-apis): A collective list of free APIs
- [n0shake/Public-APIs](https://github.com/n0shake/Public-APIs): A public list of APIs from round the web
- [public-api-lists/public-api-lists](https://github.com/public-api-lists/public-api-lists): Curated free public APIs, searchable, community maintained, with free JSON API
- [marcelscruz/public-apis](https://github.com/marcelscruz/public-apis): A collaborative list of public APIs for developers
- [googleapis/googleapis](https://github.com/googleapis/googleapis): Public interface definitions of Google APIs
### 🗺️ Roadmaps & Learning
- [nilbuild/developer-roadmap](https://github.com/nilbuild/developer-roadmap): Interactive roadmaps, guides, educational content for developer career growth
- [MoienTajik/AspNetCore-Developer-Roadmap](https://github.com/MoienTajik/AspNetCore-Developer-Roadmap): Roadmap to becoming an ASP.NET Core developer in 2026
- [OffcierCia/DeFi-Developer-Road-Map](https://github.com/OffcierCia/DeFi-Developer-Road-Map): DeFi Developer roadmap: curated handbook, tools, resources, references for DApps development
- [skydoves/android-developer-roadmap](https://github.com/skydoves/android-developer-roadmap): Android Developer Roadmap: comprehensive learning paths for Android ecosystems
- [s4kibs4mi/java-developer-roadmap](https://github.com/s4kibs4mi/java-developer-roadmap): Roadmap to becoming a Java developer in 2026
### 🏗️ System Design
- [CyC2018/CS-Notes](https://github.com/CyC2018/CS-Notes): CS notes: interview basics, Leetcode, OS, networks, system design
- [Snailclimb/JavaGuide](https://github.com/Snailclimb/JavaGuide): Java backend interview guide: CS basics, databases, distributed, concurrency, system design, AI
- [yangshun/tech-interview-handbook](https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook): Curated coding interview preparation materials for busy software engineers
- [tt-a1i/archify](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify): Turn ideas, plans, codebases into interactive diagrams or one page answers
- [binhnguyennus/awesome-scalability](https://github.com/binhnguyennus/awesome-scalability): Patterns of scalable, reliable, performant large scale systems
### 🤖 AI Agents
- [affaan-m/ECC](https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC): Agent harness performance optimization: skills, instincts, memory, security, research first development
- [deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): DeepSeek Harness: Everything is a Plugin
- [NousResearch/hermes-agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent): The agent that grows with you
- [firecrawl/firecrawl](https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl): Knowledge infrastructure for agents: search, scrape, access 550+ data providers via API
- [DietrichGebert/ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail): Makes AI agents think like lazy senior devs; best code is unwritten code
### 📚 Free Books
- [EbookFoundation/free-programming-books](https://github.com/EbookFoundation/free-programming-books): Freely available programming books
- [justjavac/free-programming-books-zh_CN](https://github.com/justjavac/free-programming-books-zh_CN): Free Chinese computer programming books; contributions welcome
- [Rafiquzzaman420/Free-Programming-Books](https://github.com/Rafiquzzaman420/Free-Programming-Books): 
- [Mr6MJT/LearnForFREE](https://github.com/Mr6MJT/LearnForFREE): Books for learning: pentesting, programming, networking, crypto, reverse engineering, web hacking
### 🔨 Build From Scratch
- [codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x](https://github.com/codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x): Master programming by recreating your favorite technologies from scratch
- [stochasticai/xTuring](https://github.com/stochasticai/xTuring): Build, personalize, control LLMs; data preprocessing to fine tuning open source LLMs
- [LuwuDynamics/xgoduck_hardware](https://github.com/LuwuDynamics/xgoduck_hardware): Build a 3D printable robot duck with mechanical models, PCB designs, BOM, guide
- [amitshekhariitbhu/build-your-own-x-machine-learning](https://github.com/amitshekhariitbhu/build-your-own-x-machine-learning): Build machine learning from scratch: linear regression, deep learning, LLMs
- [XiaomingX/build-your-own-xxx](https://github.com/XiaomingX/build-your-own-xxx): Learn programming by building web servers, databases, interpreters from scratch
### 🎯 Interview Prep
- [donnemartin/system-design-primer](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer): Learn large scale system design; interview prep with Anki flashcards
- [jwasham/coding-interview-university](https://github.com/jwasham/coding-interview-university): A complete computer science study plan to become a software engineer
- [TheAlgorithms/Python](https://github.com/TheAlgorithms/Python): All Algorithms implemented in Python
- [trekhleb/javascript-algorithms](https://github.com/trekhleb/javascript-algorithms): Algorithms and data structures in JavaScript with explanations and further readings
- [bregman-arie/devops-exercises](https://github.com/bregman-arie/devops-exercises): DevOps interview questions covering Linux, Jenkins, AWS, SRE, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
### ✨ Awesome Lists
- [sindresorhus/awesome](https://github.com/sindresorhus/awesome): Awesome lists about interesting topics; pull requests temporarily disabled
- [awesome-selfhosted/awesome-selfhosted](https://github.com/awesome-selfhosted/awesome-selfhosted): Free software network services and web applications for self hosting
- [vinta/awesome-python](https://github.com/vinta/awesome-python): Definitive Python list answering which tool to use for X
- [ossu/computer-science](https://github.com/ossu/computer-science): Path to free self taught computer science education
- [avelino/awesome-go](https://github.com/avelino/awesome-go): A curated list of awesome Go frameworks, libraries and software
